pre_correction_observation.cause: The coarse document admission guard compared grouped-statistics English prefixes case-sensitively, while the actual operation-header regexes used (?i). Cased English requests stopped before reaching those parsers.
pre_correction_observation.observed_result: Mixed-case JSON and uppercase CSV ordinary CLI inputs returned SUSPEND with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE and no result dependencies. Japanese/lowercase inputs passed their assertions before those failures; the separate mixed-value error test passed.

correction: Use (?i) prefix recognition for grouped CSV and JSON table admission to match their existing complete header regexes. Only the header admission view changes; exact input bodies, quoted column names, group keys and source bytes retain their original meaning. The parser version is advanced to bind the changed interpretation behavior.
test_state_lifecycle: An explicit test-only MINIDORA_KEEP_TEST_STATE flag retains Scratch directories. This batch enabled it and placed all pre/post/final diagnostic states under the recorded local root; the production route has no retention flag.

tests_and_route.route_method: Integration tests launch minidora-rust with --json and fresh real databases, then inspect through separate processes; no action or result is injected.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; this bounded follow-up runs the two affected grouped-statistics CLI tests, the JSON typed-stop CLI test and input unit tests, with workspace all-target compilation/lint. The earlier 160-test workspace result belongs to its separately recorded CSV snapshot.
